segments.sn19.16:1.1: “Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, gijjhakūṭā pabbatā orohanto addasaṃ asīsakaṃ kabandhaṃ [kavandhaṃ (sī. pī.)] vehāsaṃ gacchantaṃ.
segments.sn19.16:1.2: Tassa ure akkhīni ceva honti mukhañca.
segments.sn19.16:1.3: Tamenaṃ gijjhāpi kākāpi kulalāpi anupatitvā anupatitvā vitacchenti virājenti.
segments.sn19.16:1.5: eso, bhikkhave, satto imasmiṃyeva rājagahe hāriko nāma coraghātako ahosi…pe….

lines: Coraghātavatthusmiṃ so rañño āṇāya dīgharattaṃ corānaṃ sīsāni chinditvā petaloke nibbattanto asīsakaṃ kabandhaṃ hutvā nibbatti.
Asīsakaṃ kabandhaṃ hutvā nibbatti kammāyūhanakāle tathā nimittaggahaṇaparicayato. 7-11.
